change_summary.intent: Expose bounded source capture through verify source-graph so an operator can inspect and retain the pin used by native frozen module execution before evaluation.

changed_signatures: Optional source pin in serialized RuntimeConfig; explicit constructors initialize None

operational_impact.operator_notes: verify source-graph uses the existing bounded source_graph::capture and franken-node/module-source-graph/v2 report without guest evaluation, network access or dependency installation. It returns zero only for complete capture within the declared static request scope, and one for incomplete capture or input errors. Runtime completeness and release certification remain false. Contained symlinks require explicit opt-in, matching run's frozen-module-symlinks policy. Omitting the run pin preserves existing behavior. A supplied pin must be canonical and requires frozen execution. The existing resolver consumes exactly the capture it validates. This is operator-selected integrity, not registry-signed provenance or an authority grant.
required_actions: Retain the reviewed graph hash outside guest-writable source and explicitly approve a new pin after intended source or resolution changes.

compatibility.details: Default serialized configs omit the new optional field and existing CLI/config behavior is preserved. Rust callers using explicit RuntimeConfig struct literals must initialize the new optional field. Explicit pins require updated source builds; CLI takes precedence over TOML. Resource, capability, trust, containment and parser restrictions continue to apply.
